scope: KTAPEOUT 0.5.0 public Core, Runtime, CLI, and offline Kaspa Verifier using the pinned official Rusty Kaspa v2.1.0 commit

upstream_pin.provenance: The official repository commit API resolves this exact revision; it is not a fork. The official v2.0.1 tag resolves to cfafeb4c093fa37a303f1b9f19c58f986b870ce3.
upstream_pin.rationale: Keep v2.1.0: upstream 2a47b249 (Arithmetic safety and more, PR 1138) bounds compressed and uncompressed block-header parents. TN10 verify converts untrusted RpcBlock headers through this code before recomputing commitments. v2.0.1 lacks this input bound. The regression upstream_parent_limit_rejects_oversized_untrusted_rpc_headers exercises the required rejection. This pin does not establish real-network validation or waive advisories.
